questions.question: Q11. Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order . P. The average adult gets two to four colds a year, while the average child may get six to eight. Q. It is the most frequent infectious disease in humans. R. They occur more commonly during the winter. S. The common cold, also known simply as the cold, is a viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory tract that primarily affects the nose.
questions.questionHtml:
Q11. Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

P. The average adult gets two to four colds a year, while the average child may get six to eight.

Q. It is the most frequent infectious disease in humans.

R. They occur more commonly during the winter.

S. The common cold, also known simply as the cold, is a viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory tract that primarily affects the nose.
questions.solution: The common cold, also known simply as the cold, is a viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory tract that primarily affects the nose. It is the most frequent infectious disease in humans. The average adult gets two to four colds a year, while the average child may get six to eight. They occur more commonly during the winter.

questions.solution: B) Replace "I was groomed/ I was be groomed" with "I was be groomed" because the structure "was/were + being + past participle" is used for the past continuous passive voice.
